name: usage-limit-codex
description: Codex turn that starts normally, then hits the account's usage limit: an `error` notification with codexErrorInfo "usageLimitExceeded" and willRetry false, followed by turn/completed with turn.status "failed" and turn.error populated. Pins that the fatal branch classifies the failure as FailureReasonUsageLimit (transient, turn-bounded) rather than a plain fatal error, which is what parks a workflow run as OutcomeProviderUsageLimited instead of failing it, and that the turn still closes through the wire lifecycle rather than a synthesized completion. Wire shape verified against codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v2 (ErrorNotification, TurnError, CodexErrorInfo::UsageLimitExceeded, which serializes as the bare camelCase string).

lines: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"error","params":{"threadId":"${THREAD_ID}","turnId":"${TURN_ID}","willRetry":false,"error":{"message":"You've hit your usage limit. Try again later.","codexErrorInfo":"usageLimitExceeded","additionalDetails":null}}}

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"turn/completed","params":{"threadId":"${THREAD_ID}","turn":{"id":"${TURN_ID}","status":"failed","error":{"message":"You've hit your usage limit. Try again later.","codexErrorInfo":"usageLimitExceeded"}}}}
